synthesis: GET /api/scout/shift/status lazily materializes an open kit_shifts row (EnsureOpenShift::currentOpenForKit -> forKit) and fires ShiftStart analytics + a Spatie audit log the first time a driver's poll observes recent scan activity. The Sanctum force-login token minted for admin impersonation carries the literal `clarity-scout-force` ability; ClarityScoutMiddleware treats it as an unconditional bypass but does NOT bypass the controller body, so an impersonating admin polling /shift/status runs EnsureOpenShift exactly like a real driver and opens a real shift on the driver's kit, polluting shift/analytics/audit data. Fix: gate the lazy-open + ShiftStart emit in status() on !$user->isScoutForceImpersonator(), returning the normal no-open-shift payload.

scope.summary: Guard ClarityScoutShiftController::status() so a force-login impersonator never triggers EnsureOpenShift's lazy kit_shifts creation nor the ShiftStart analytics/audit emit; return the standard no-open-shift JSON shape instead. Optional belt-and-suspenders: gate the frontend End Shift button on !auth.isImpersonating (button already hides once status() returns open:false).

proposed_changes.change: In status(), short-circuit before $this->ensureOpenShift->currentOpenForKit($kit) when $user->isScoutForceImpersonator(); return the existing no-open-shift JSON shape without touching EnsureOpenShift or the ShiftStart Analytics/audit emit.
proposed_changes.reason: Sole lazy-open + ShiftStart emit site (exhaustiveness sweep + grep backstop confirm no other caller).

out_of_scope: end() guard — Dalton decided (2026-07-24): JUST START, match the ticket. end()'s impersonation side effect (own lazy-create fallback + unconditional ShiftEnd) is a KNOWN RESIDUAL noted for a possible follow-up ticket.
Frontend defense-in-depth (End Shift !auth.isImpersonating guard) — Dalton decided: BACKEND-ONLY. Backend fix already satisfies AC3; no Vue change / no asset rebuild.
EnsureOpenShift.php internals — generic helper correctly reused; guard belongs at the controller call site.
ClarityScoutMiddleware bypass behavior — intentional (lets impersonators reach the PWA), not the bug.
CloseInactiveShiftsCommand — scheduled system caller of forKit(), not an impersonation path.
Any ClickHouse-side Scout data — the shift path is 100% Postgres.

acceptance_criteria.item: An impersonating admin polling GET /api/scout/shift/status creates no kit_shifts row and fires no ShiftStart analytics/audit events.
A normal (non-impersonated) driver's shift-start behavior (lazy open + ShiftStart emit) is unchanged.
The Scout PWA shows no open shift (End Shift hidden) while impersonating.
acceptance_criteria.reason: Satisfied by the backend fix; optional frontend guard hardens it.

questions.q: Also guard the shift close path end() (POST /api/scout/shift/end)? It has its own independent lazy-create fallback ($latest ?? $this->ensureOpenShift->forKit($kit)) and fires ShiftEnd analytics UNCONDITIONALLY before checking whether anything was newly closed — so an impersonator hitting End Shift can create-and-immediately-close a zero-activity kit_shifts row and emit a ShiftEnd event as a pure impersonation side effect. Ticket reported symptom is start only.
questions.answer: JUST START — match the ticket's reported scope; do NOT guard end(). end()'s impersonation side effect is a KNOWN RESIDUAL for a possible follow-up.

questions.q: Include the optional frontend defense-in-depth (gate End Shift button on !auth.isImpersonating) or keep the diff backend-only?
questions.answer: BACKEND-ONLY. Backend fix already satisfies AC3 (button gates on shift.open). No Vue change / no asset rebuild.

questions.q: Does isScoutForceImpersonator() check the correct token ability and is it the right single source of truth?
questions.answer: Yes — User.php:252 uses in_array('clarity-scout-force', currentAccessToken()?->abilities ?? [], true), an exact-membership check (not tokenCan which a * token satisfies). Established SoT used by ClarityScoutMiddleware/AuthController/MapController.

notes: Only two real lazy-materialization sites for kit_shifts: EnsureOpenShift::currentOpenForKit() (called only from status()) and EnsureOpenShift::forKit() (from currentOpenForKit, end()'s fallback, and CloseInactiveShiftsCommand — a scheduled system job).
Grep backstop confirmed: all other ->forKit() hits are an unrelated ClickHouse Scan/Hit query scope; ShiftStart appears only as the ScoutAnalyticsEvent enum case; no missed EnsureOpenShift caller.
end() fires Analytics::track(ShiftEnd) unconditionally before the newlyClosed check — pre-existing quirk that compounds the impersonation-on-end concern; relevant to questions[0].

Test convention: PHPUnit #[Test] attrs; impersonation tokens via createToken('name', ['*','clarity-scout-force']) (pattern in ClarityScoutMapControllerTest.php:260, ClarityScoutMiddlewareTest.php:121).

Existing ClarityScoutShiftControllerTest.php mocks Analytics::shouldReceive('track')->zeroOrMoreTimes(); tighten in the new tests to assert zero ShiftStart for impersonator and >=1 for the normal driver.

Shift path is 100% PostgreSQL (Scan read, KitShift write) — no RequiresClickhouse. Auto-open reads recent Postgres zod.scans, so QA must seed Postgres scans (memory: scout-shift-gate-reads-postgres-scans).

tests.what_it_pins: Impersonator token ['*','clarity-scout-force'] + fresh matching scan activity + no existing shift: GET /shift/status returns the no-open-shift shape, KitShift count unchanged, Analytics::track never called with ShiftStart.
Regression: normal scout token + same scan activity still opens a shift (wasRecentlyCreated) and fires ShiftStart (AC2).
IF end() brought into scope: impersonator token calling POST /shift/end on a kit with zero shift history creates no kit_shifts row and fires no ShiftEnd.

grounding.code_flow: GET /shift/status -> ClarityScoutMiddleware (full bypass for clarity-scout-force) -> status() -> EnsureOpenShift::currentOpenForKit -> [no open row + recent Scan] -> forKit -> KitShift::create (Postgres) -> if wasRecentlyCreated: Analytics::track(ShiftStart) + logShiftActivity -> JSON. POST /shift/end -> same bypass -> unconditional Analytics::track(ShiftEnd) -> tx: latest KitShift else forKit fallback, force-fill ended_at/end_type, save -> SendEndOfShiftSummary + logShiftActivity only if newlyClosed.
